So far, we've received confirmation for first option only - Monday, Sep 07 at 1400 UTC. Let's wait till tomorrow, and if no one has an alternate suggestion, we will go ahead with Monday? Here is the agenda: https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/204 Yeah, let's see for the date. We can update it as needed. If people can add comments or ping me here about discussion topics, I'll add them to the list 😄 My impression was that we're planning to discuss only EIP-2718 in this meeting. Do people want to include EIP-2929 as well in the agenda? Oh, my bad. I thought it was all of YOLOv2, but 2718 was clearly the biggest bit of it. No worries! I think we can have a discussion focused on EIP-2718 and it being on YOLOv2. If time permits and we have the right set of people on call, other EIPs considered for YOLOv2 may also be discussed. Can we add the breakout room EIP to the channel text? It will help me keep track of what we are talking about where easier. <@!187490121698770945> are you talking about the channel name? Yes breakout-room (EIP-2718) or something like that. I can make the edit, I wanted to get feedback first if others agreed it is a good idea. I think we should avoid labeling the breakout-room for specific EIPs, because that will very quickly create a ton of channels when really the breakout room should be to organize calls with some context around the issues brought up in the ACD calls primarily Could we reuse this one? It would be nice to see the current topic of the breakout room, even it it rolls into different ones as we go
